summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MeetFlow iCal Export feature. All 9 backend tests passed. All frontend UI elements verified - 'Zum Kalender' buttons present on Dashboard (scheduled meetings), Schedule Detail (confirmed polls), Public Poll (confirmed), and Public Booking (confirmation page).
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/meetings/{meeting_id}/ical returns valid .ics file with VCALENDAR, VEVENT, DTSTART, DTEND, SUMMARY, UID
Backend: GET /api/schedule-polls/{poll_id}/ical returns .ics for confirmed poll
Backend: GET /api/schedule-polls/{poll_id}/ical returns 400 for unconfirmed poll
Backend: GET /api/bookings/{booking_id}/ical returns valid .ics for booking
Backend: iCal files contain correct Content-Type (text/calendar) and Content-Disposition headers
Backend: iCal files contain required fields (PRODID, VERSION, UID, SUMMARY, DTSTART, DTEND)
Frontend Dashboard: 'Zum Kalender' option visible in meeting dropdown menu for scheduled meetings
Frontend Schedule Detail: 'Zum Kalender' button visible in confirmed info section for confirmed polls
Frontend Public Poll: 'Zum Kalender' button visible for confirmed polls
Frontend Public Booking: 'Zum Kalender hinzufuegen' button visible on booking confirmation page
seed_data_creation: Created test meetings (TEST_iCal_Scheduled_Meeting, TEST_iCal_Content_Validation), test booking (TEST_iCal_Booking_Guest). Used existing confirmed poll (TEST_ConfirmPoll_Playwright).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iCal feature fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/meetings/{id}/ical (public, returns .ics for any meeting with scheduled_at), GET /api/schedule-polls/{id}/ical (public, returns .ics only for confirmed polls, 400 for unconfirmed), GET /api/bookings/{id}/ical (public, returns .ics for bookings). Frontend buttons: Dashboard dropdown menu has 'Zum Kalender' for scheduled meetings (menu-ical-{id} testid), Schedule Detail page has 'Zum Kalender' button (add-to-calendar testid) in confirmed info section, Public Poll page has 'Zum Kalender' button (public-add-to-calendar testid) for confirmed polls, Public Booking confirmation has 'Zum Kalender hinzufuegen' button (booking-add-to-calendar testid). All buttons open the iCal endpoint URL in new tab to trigger .ics download.

mocked_apis.email_sending: Email sending is simulated (logged to console) without valid Resend/SendGrid API key

notes: iCal feature implementation is complete and working correctly. The icalendar Python library is used to generate valid .ics files. All three endpoints (meetings, schedule-polls, bookings) return properly formatted iCalendar files with correct MIME type (text/calendar) and Content-Disposition headers for file download. Frontend integration uses CalendarPlus icon from lucide-react and opens the API URL in a new tab to trigger the download.
